thread:
ria: Quick note - samplekit onboarding: function-calling + json_mode + retry is producing quoted JSON in arguments for Python users. New users hit TypeError when passing to tools.

joel: Which SDK version?

cia-bot: Detected failing onboarding run for user 'alice' (session 88).

ria: py sdk 0.9.6. Minimal repro: call tool with json_mode=True and retry=True; final message.function_call.arguments prints like "{\"name\":\"Sam\"}" instead of dict.

sam: Sounds like we serialize twice on retry assembly. TS SDK auto-parses final string into object; python helper doesn't.

joel: Short-term: update quickstart to json.loads(arguments) if isinstance(args, str) and note retry quirk. Long-term: change stream coalescer to attempt one json.loads on final string and only json.dumps when input is bytes.

cia-bot: Created issue #4218: "py-sdk: avoid double-encode for function_call.arguments on retry". CI job started for branch fix/fncall-retry-parse.

ria: I'll add the doc note and a test in samplekit. Thanks.
